fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Trading pair, for example BTCUSDT.

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: Start of the hourly window in UTC.

fields.name: open
fields.description: First one-minute open in the hour.

fields.name: high
fields.description: Highest one-minute high in the hour.

fields.name: low
fields.description: Lowest one-minute low in the hour.

fields.name: close
fields.description: Last one-minute close in the hour.

fields.name: volume
fields.description: Base-asset volume traded in the hour.

fields.name: quote_volume
fields.description: Quote-asset volume traded in the hour.

fields.name: trade_count
fields.description: Number of trades in the hour.

fields.name: vwap
fields.description: Volume-weighted average price for the hour.

fields.name: log_return_1h
fields.description: Natural log of close over the previous hour close.

fields.name: realized_vol_1h
fields.description: Standard deviation of one-minute log returns inside the hour.

fields.name: rv_ewma_24h
fields.description: Exponentially weighted volatility with a 24-hour span.

fields.name: source
fields.description: binance_ws, binance_vision, or mixed when the hour has both.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Materialization timestamp; excluded from idempotence hashes.

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Iceberg partition column, derived from window_start.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Trading pair.

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: Feature window boundary and label window start (UTC).

fields.name: ret_5m
fields.description: Log return over the trailing 5 minutes.

fields.name: ret_15m
fields.description: Log return over the trailing 15 minutes.

fields.name: ret_60m
fields.description: Log return over the trailing 60 minutes.

fields.name: rv_5m
fields.description: Realized volatility over the trailing 5 minutes.

fields.name: rv_15m
fields.description: Realized volatility over the trailing 15 minutes.

fields.name: rv_60m
fields.description: Realized volatility over the trailing 60 minutes.

fields.name: volume_z_60m
fields.description: Volume z-score against the trailing 60 minutes.

fields.name: trade_count_60m
fields.description: Trades in the trailing 60 minutes.

fields.name: hl_range_1m
fields.description: High-low range of the last minute, divided by close.

fields.name: vwap_dev
fields.description: Close deviation from the trailing 60-minute VWAP.

fields.name: sent_mean_1h
fields.description: Mean sentiment of posts in the previous hour.

fields.name: sent_pos_share
fields.description: Positive share of posts in the previous hour.

fields.name: sent_neg_share
fields.description: Negative share of posts in the previous hour.

fields.name: post_count_1h
fields.description: Post volume in the previous hour.

fields.name: engagement_1h
fields.description: Engagement per post in the previous hour.

fields.name: label_rv_next_1h
fields.description: Realized volatility over (window_start, window_start + 1h].

fields.name: label_start
fields.description: Label window start, always equal to window_start.

fields.name: label_end
fields.description: Label window end, always window_start + 1 hour.

fields.name: feature_snapshot_id
fields.description: Iceberg snapshot or build id the features came from.

fields.name: dq_status
fields.description: pass when every feature and the label are present, else warn.

fields.name: event_date
fields.description: Iceberg partition column, derived from window_start.

fields.name: event_hour
fields.description: Workplan alias for window_start; same value, kept for the W1-C contract.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: Workplan alias for feature_snapshot_id; same value.

fields.name: window_start
fields.description: Start of the hourly window in UTC.

fields.name: post_count
fields.description: Unique posts created in the hour; 0 for an empty hour.

fields.name: unique_authors
fields.description: Distinct pseudonymized authors in the hour.

fields.name: mean_sentiment
fields.description: Mean VADER compound score in [-1, 1]; null when empty.

fields.name: positive_share
fields.description: Share of posts labelled positive; null when empty.

fields.name: negative_share
fields.description: Share of posts labelled negative; null when empty.

fields.name: neutral_share
fields.description: Share of posts labelled neutral; null when empty.

fields.name: total_likes
fields.description: Sum of likes across the hour's posts.

fields.name: total_reposts
fields.description: Sum of reposts across the hour's posts.

fields.name: total_replies
fields.description: Sum of replies across the hour's posts.

fields.name: engagement_per_post
fields.description: Likes plus reposts plus replies, divided by post_count.

fields.name: top_hashtags
fields.description: Up to five hashtags ordered by frequency.

fields.name: sentiment_model_version
fields.description: Lexicon or model version that produced the scores.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Materialization timestamp; excluded from idempotence hashes.
